issue: Propensity is not incremental response to a campaign.
action: Use randomized treatment/control data before optimizing coupon uplift.

issue: Demographics cover only 32.0% of transaction households.
action: Retain Unknown explicitly and report segment metrics only with adequate support.

issue: DAY is an integer index without a calendar-date mapping.
action: Avoid claims about real-world seasonality; validate calendar mapping if available.

issue: QUANTITY uses a scaled convention for fuel and miscellaneous sales; it is not a comparable count of physical items.
action: Exclude raw QUANTITY from propensity V2; use baskets, lines and diversity.

issue: Causal media data is product-store-week level and very large.
action: Join only point-in-time media exposure aggregates needed by a defined use case.
